name: github-greenlantern
description: Turn a seven-row GitHub contribution calendar into a glowing Green Lantern animation.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json && node --input-type=module -e "import { copyFileSync } from 'node:fs'; copyFileSync('src/preview/styles.css', 'build/src/preview/styles.css');"
scripts.demo: npm run build && node build/src/cli.js --user demo --fixture test/fixtures/demo.json --output dist/demo
